name: RCA DOFSTA oxygen gain, Cabled-09 RR1809-RR1812 (2018), Oregon Offshore Shallow Profiler

annotations.annotation: On Saturday, September 16, 2017 at around 12:15 GMT, the CA Shallow Profiler at Endurance (CE04OSPS) went offline due to an overcurrent power event. Initial investigation indicated external aggression on one of the two anchor legs, pulling the platform that is normally fixed at 200m below the surface to 400m, and then rose to 100m before communications were lost. No data products are expected from CE04OSPS until the platform is re-deployed. For more information, please contact help@oceanobservatories.org

rca:flags.text: The .cnv has no sbox0Mm/Kg column, so shipboard SBE43 oxygen was converted from ml/l to umol/kg with the Sea-Bird formula (ml/l x 44660 / (EOS-80 sigma-theta + 1000)), using sal00, t090C and prDM.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied, which matters for the SBE43 oxygen sensor.
Winkler oxygen is the discrete summary's mL/L value converted to umol/kg with the Sea-Bird formula, using the CTD salinity 1, temperature 1 and pressure at each bottle closure.
Winkler bottles deeper than the profiler's deepest sample (196 m) are not used for the ship-sensor gain: 0 of 6 rows from the summary left out.
